sections.title: Eligibility and preparation
sections.text:
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
A UChicago bachelor's completed before enrollment is an eligible degree route; international F 1 applicants are
accepted. Preparation normally includes advanced algebra, rigorous analysis and topology with linear
algebra/advanced calculus; year-long algebra and analysis are typical preparation for 8000-level courses.
Actual transcript/GPA remains to be assessed. [s1] [s3]
Before submission [2027 confirmed]
Application opened September 1, 2026. Select the Mathematics Ph D (also the route for applied mathematics);
prepare advanced-course/textbook/topics list, CV, statement, unofficial transcripts and three referees. No
advance supervisor approval stated. Check English coursework exemption and separate TA certification;
request any eligible fee subsidy before paying. [s1] [s2] [s6]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
No supervisor consent prerequisite stated. Faculty below grouped by research, with adjacent and emeritus
cases labelled. Current roster and recent papers checked; presence does not guarantee new students.
Tsao-Hsien Chen,Kai-Wen Lan,Tian-Jun Li listed on 2026-27 sabbatical, which does not itself rule out Fall 2027
supervision. [s1] [s17] [s18] [s19] [s20] [s21]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
Graduate School online application: Academic History transcripts; Test Scores self-report; Materials
statements/CV/course list/optional sample; Recommendations three referees. Check status before/after
submission. No updated transcripts after the deadline. Ask Math coordinator if a referee has technical trouble.
[s1] [s3] [s4]

not 2027-28. GRE exclusion is explicit standing policy. Older admissions/funding pages are retained only as

sections.title: English and GRE
sections.text:
English requirement [Standing rule]
For nonexempt applicants: TOEFL after Jan 21, 2026 overall 4.5, writing 4.5, reading 4.5 (old 79/W 21/R 19);
IELTS 6.5 overall/W/R; Fall 2027 DET 120 overall/W/R (older Spring/Summer 2027 minimum 115); PTE 59
overall/W/R; Cambridge C1 Advanced 180 overall/W/R. Tests valid within 2 years of program start. TOEFLHome
Edition and IELTSOnline accepted; My Best and IELTSOne Skill Retake not. Math prefers TOEFL and old-scale
speaking≥23. TA table now maps speaking 4.5-5 to all teaching with GRAD 5105;5.5-6 clears coursework;
waiver/no score requires SETTA. IELTS 8.5-9 clears,7-8 needs GRAD 5105. Admission exemption is not a TA
exemption. [s1] [s6] [s13] [s14]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
Likely exempt from admission testing if UChicago study includes at least 16 semester or 24 quarter non-ESL
credits completed within the past 2 years while physically living in the US. Degree completion is not required
for this coursework route. Confirm actual credits/dates and whether any remote study affects eligibility. This is
an inference from the official rule, not an individual approval. [s6]
GRE General; GRE Mathematics [Standing rule]
Not reviewed. Department explicitly states that submitted GRE General or Subject scores will not be
considered in admissions; do not spend money sending them for this program. [s1]

sections.title: Recommendation letters
sections.text:
Number and type [Standing rule]
Three. Normally mathematicians who know your advanced coursework or research. Only letters from referees
named in the application are accepted. [s1]
Scholarship references [Unresolved]
No extra ordinary assistantship reference identified. DOVE uses a director questionnaire and nominee
responses, but F 1 international applicants are ineligible. Separate awards can have additional requirements
not established for entry funding. [s1] [s9] [s10] [s23]
What sends the invitation [Unresolved]
Listed referees receive an application-system email with upload instructions. Central instructions permit
checking recommendations before submission, and another UMN department explicitly permits letters before
submission. Exact click trigger/immediacy for Math is not publicly documented; do not assume typing alone
sends. [s1] [s4] [s16]
Before versus after submission [Standing rule]
Letters can be submitted before or after the applicant submits, per cross-program UMN system guidance;
Math's deadline still applies. No evidence invitations are restricted to after submission. [s4] [s16]
Receipt confirmation [Standing rule]
Before submission: Recommendations page. After submission: Application Status page. Central instructions
explicitly document both. Cross-program FAQ documents reminder emails from the submitted application
status page. [s4] [s16]
Updating and reusing letters [Unresolved]
Public central/Math pages do not establish replacement of completed letters or reuse across cycles. Ask the
coordinator; do not infer permission from reminder functionality. If access rights are not waived, Minnesota
policy permits requesting letters upon application submission under MGDPA; waiver prevents later access. [s4]
[s16]

sections.title: Written materials
sections.text:
Academic CV / resume [Standing rule]
Required academic CV uploaded under Materials: work, awards, scholarships/grants, coursework, research and
publications. No public page/font/spacing cap found. [s1]
Statement of purpose [Standing rule]
Required document is called Personal Statement, functioning as the academic SOP; approximately 2 pages,
uploaded Materials. Prompt paraphrase: mathematical background and route into math, interesting
coursework, research, persistence/motivation, potential area and why, reasons for Minnesota and further math
study. Specific research interests are not expected. If requesting master's fallback, explain why Minnesota's
master's and fit with any chosen emphasis. Prompts are guidance rather than mandatory question-by-question
answers; no font/spacing rule stated. [s1]

Personal / background statement [Standing rule]
Optional Diversity of Views (DOVE) Statement: explain distinctive perspectives/life experiences, including
successfully overcoming obstacles where relevant, and how they would broaden peers' education. General
statement guideline approximately 2 pages; a distinct DOVE-only hard limit is not stated. This admissions
option does not make an F 1 student eligible for the similarly named fellowship. [s1] [s10]
Research-interest statement [Standing rule]
Part of the required statement if known; no separate required research-interest essay. Department explicitly
does not expect entering students to have fixed research interests. [s1]
Research proposal [Standing rule]
No mandatory research proposal listed for Ph D entry. [s1]
Writing sample / thesis / research summary [Standing rule]
Optional articles/publications may be uploaded in Materials/Writing Sample. No public page/file/number cap or
mandatory thesis requirement located; upload is supported rather than link-only instruction. [s1]
Publications list [Standing rule]
Include publications in CV; optional paper upload available. No independent mandatory publications list found.
[s1]

Required advanced mathematics list beyond calculus and introductory linear algebra. Include completed,
current and planned courses: name, term, grade when available, textbook title/author, and course topics or
chapters covered. Bullet or table format allowed; no course-count cap published. [s1]

Ordinary TA review is automatic. DOVE fellowship requires nominee prompt responses plus DGS questionnaire;
linked Google Docs could not be read by the public browser, so exact prompts/limits remain unverified. The
applicant's F 1 status excludes this fellowship. Optional DOVE admissions statement remains available. [s1] [s2]
[s10] [s22] [s23]
Other short answers / materials [Unresolved]
No other Math-specific mandatory essay located beyond statement, CV, advanced-course list and optional
DOVE/sample. Live portal formatting and any short answers should be checked before drafting. Official wording
is linked; prompts here are paraphrases. [s1]

sections.title: Funding and fees
sections.text:
Amount and coverage [Prior cycle]
Current Math assistantship page states a minimum annual $25,750, without clearly specifying 9 versus 12
months. Explicit 2026-27 hourly rates:$33.02 before candidacy,$34.67 advanced. Neither is a confirmed Fall
2027 guarantee; do not annualize hourly pay without appointment weeks/hours. Historical Fall 2022
admissions quoted $20,000; older 2022-23 CSE fellowship $26,500/9 months is not current. DOVE Fall 2027 is
$25,000 academic year plus tuition/health but ineligible for F 1. [s8] [s9] [s10] [s24]
Years of support [Standing rule]
All admitted Ph D offers come with funding, normally TA; renewable up to 6 years subject to conditions and
progress. Summer employment is separate unless offer explicitly includes it. [s1] [s8]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
International students can hold ordinary graduate assistantships subject to enrollment/work authorization and
TA language certification. DOVE explicitly excludes international temporary-status students; F 1 does not meet
its lawful-nontemporary category. Federal citizen/PR-restricted fellowships should not be assumed available.
[s1] [s10] [s11] [s13]

Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
Assistantship percentage determines tuition/health. Central 50% appointment yields full eligible
tuition;2026-27 caps $10,962/semester coursework or $1,827 advanced. Required registration normally 6
credits coursework or 1 advanced; thresholds≥98 hours for prorated tuition,≥195 semester hours for
health/nonresident benefits. Fees are separate. GA health 2026-27: employee charge $244.88 each semester;
at 50% university pays listed remaining $775.46/month, with total plan premium $854.18 including surcharge.
Summer coverage conditional; no Fall 2027 premium assumed. TA English waiver/no score requires SETTA;
lower scores restrict duties or require courses. [s11] [s12] [s13] [s14]
Extra funding application [2027 confirmed]
Ph D application automatically requests ordinary support. CSE/department scholarships generally nominated.
DOVE director nomination deadline February 10, 2027,5 p.m. Central; internal departmental date may be
earlier, but F 1 not eligible. Two nominee limit per program; no self-nomination. [s2] [s9] [s10]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
Department donor awards and supplements, later adviser-supported RA/summer teaching, CSE recruitment
fellowships and later IDF/DDF/SEED opportunities. Amounts and eligibility depend on award; do not treat older
CSE 2022-23 or external federal figures as Fall 2027 guarantees. [s8] [s9]
Application fee [Standing rule]
International application $95; domestic $75. Nonrefundable, paid by credit card upon submission. F 1 applicant
falls in international category despite US undergraduate study. [s5]
Fee waiver [Standing rule]
Current Fall 2027 Math page says its general fee-waiver application is closed and it will not consider other
requests now. Math Alliance F-GAP participants should send their qualifying letter to the coordinator for
associated waiver. Domestic Free App encouraged but ordinary F 1 not eligible. Central Graduate School itself
does not generally grant fee waivers; program subsidies are distinct. [s1] [s5]

Eligibility and preparation
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
A UChicago bachelor's completed before enrollment is an eligible degree route; international F 1 applicants are
accepted. Preparation normally includes advanced algebra, rigorous analysis and topology with linear
algebra/advanced calculus; year-long algebra and analysis are typical preparation for 8000-level courses.
Actual transcript/GPA remains to be assessed. [s1] [s3]
Before submission [2027 confirmed]
Application opened September 1, 2026. Select the Mathematics Ph D (also the route for applied mathematics);
prepare advanced-course/textbook/topics list, CV, statement, unofficial transcripts and three referees. No
advance supervisor approval stated. Check English coursework exemption and separate TA certification;
request any eligible fee subsidy before paying. [s1] [s2] [s6]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
No supervisor consent prerequisite stated. Faculty below grouped by research, with adjacent and emeritus
cases labelled. Current roster and recent papers checked; presence does not guarantee new students.
Tsao-Hsien Chen,Kai-Wen Lan,Tian-Jun Li listed on 2026-27 sabbatical, which does not itself rule out Fall 2027
supervision. [s1] [s17] [s18] [s19] [s20] [s21]

Graduate School online application: Academic History transcripts; Test Scores self-report; Materials
statements/CV/course list/optional sample; Recommendations three referees. Check status before/after
submission. No updated transcripts after the deadline. Ask Math coordinator if a referee has technical trouble.

Academic application; Funding consideration [2027 confirmed]
December 15, 2026 for Fall 2027. No time/time zone published. Complete Ph D admission application is
automatically considered for funding; fall-only, no rolling admissions. DOVE nominations are separate and
unavailable to ordinary F 1 international applicants. [s1] [s2]
Reference receipt; Supporting documents [2027 confirmed]
Use December 15, 2026 as the complete-file deadline. No separate public reference grace or later document
deadline established. Mathematics explicitly will not accept updated transcripts after the deadline,
understanding that many Fall grades are unavailable. [s1]
Test-score receipt [2027 confirmed]
Self-reported unofficial English scores suffice for departmental complete-file review by December 15, 2026;
official scores are processed centrally throughout admission and are still required where no exemption applies.
No precise later official-score deadline was established for Math. GREs are not reviewed. [s1] [s6]
Accepting an offer [Standing rule]
Central standing policy references April 15 for funded offers. Confirm Fall 2027 offer terms and any required
interim response; old CGS membership cannot independently establish new 2027 participation. General central
decisions commonly arrive February-April; not a guaranteed Math decision date. [s3] [s15]
English and GRE
English requirement [Standing rule]
For nonexempt applicants: TOEFL after Jan 21, 2026 overall 4.5, writing 4.5, reading 4.5 (old 79/W 21/R 19);
IELTS 6.5 overall/W/R; Fall 2027 DET 120 overall/W/R (older Spring/Summer 2027 minimum 115); PTE 59
overall/W/R; Cambridge C1 Advanced 180 overall/W/R. Tests valid within 2 years of program start. TOEFLHome
Edition and IELTSOnline accepted; My Best and IELTSOne Skill Retake not. Math prefers TOEFL and old-scale
speaking≥23. TA table now maps speaking 4.5-5 to all teaching with GRAD 5105;5.5-6 clears coursework;
waiver/no score requires SETTA. IELTS 8.5-9 clears,7-8 needs GRAD 5105. Admission exemption is not a TA
exemption. [s1] [s6] [s13] [s14]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
Likely exempt from admission testing if UChicago study includes at least 16 semester or 24 quarter non-ESL
credits completed within the past 2 years while physically living in the US. Degree completion is not required
for this coursework route. Confirm actual credits/dates and whether any remote study affects eligibility. This is
an inference from the official rule, not an individual approval. [s6]
GRE General; GRE Mathematics [Standing rule]
Not reviewed. Department explicitly states that submitted GRE General or Subject scores will not be
considered in admissions; do not spend money sending them for this program. [s1]
Academic records
Transcripts and degree records [Standing rule]
Upload unofficial postsecondary records in Academic History; include all institutions and unfinished study
under central rules, with degree evidence if awarded and originals plus English translations where needed.
Math emphasizes degree-seeking coursework. Official records only after admission/matriculation, before
enrollment. No updated transcript after December 15. [s1] [s7]

Mathematics-course list [Standing rule]
Required advanced mathematics list beyond calculus and introductory linear algebra. Include completed,
current and planned courses: name, term, grade when available, textbook title/author, and course topics or
chapters covered. Bullet or table format allowed; no course-count cap published. [s1]
Course descriptions [Standing rule]
Course content/topics or textbook chapters are explicitly required inside the advanced-course list. A separate
complete syllabus upload is not listed. [s1]
Recommendation letters
Number and type [Standing rule]
Three. Normally mathematicians who know your advanced coursework or research. Only letters from referees
named in the application are accepted. [s1]
Scholarship references [Unresolved]
No extra ordinary assistantship reference identified. DOVE uses a director questionnaire and nominee
responses, but F 1 international applicants are ineligible. Separate awards can have additional requirements
not established for entry funding. [s1] [s9] [s10] [s23]
What sends the invitation [Unresolved]
Listed referees receive an application-system email with upload instructions. Central instructions permit
checking recommendations before submission, and another UMN department explicitly permits letters before
submission. Exact click trigger/immediacy for Math is not publicly documented; do not assume typing alone
sends. [s1] [s4] [s16]
Before versus after submission [Standing rule]
Letters can be submitted before or after the applicant submits, per cross-program UMN system guidance;
Math's deadline still applies. No evidence invitations are restricted to after submission. [s4] [s16]
Receipt confirmation [Standing rule]
Before submission: Recommendations page. After submission: Application Status page. Central instructions
explicitly document both. Cross-program FAQ documents reminder emails from the submitted application
status page. [s4] [s16]
Updating and reusing letters [Unresolved]
Public central/Math pages do not establish replacement of completed letters or reuse across cycles. Ask the
coordinator; do not infer permission from reminder functionality. If access rights are not waived, Minnesota
policy permits requesting letters upon application submission under MGDPA; waiver prevents later access. [s4]
[s16]
Written materials
Academic CV / resume [Standing rule]
Required academic CV uploaded under Materials: work, awards, scholarships/grants, coursework, research and
publications. No public page/font/spacing cap found. [s1]
Statement of purpose [Standing rule]
Required document is called Personal Statement, functioning as the academic SOP; approximately 2 pages,
uploaded Materials. Prompt paraphrase: mathematical background and route into math, interesting
coursework, research, persistence/motivation, potential area and why, reasons for Minnesota and further math
study. Specific research interests are not expected. If requesting master's fallback, explain why Minnesota's
master's and fit with any chosen emphasis. Prompts are guidance rather than mandatory question-by-question
answers; no font/spacing rule stated. [s1]

Funding and fees
Amount and coverage [Prior cycle]
Current Math assistantship page states a minimum annual $25,750, without clearly specifying 9 versus 12
months. Explicit 2026-27 hourly rates:$33.02 before candidacy,$34.67 advanced. Neither is a confirmed Fall
2027 guarantee; do not annualize hourly pay without appointment weeks/hours. Historical Fall 2022
admissions quoted $20,000; older 2022-23 CSE fellowship $26,500/9 months is not current. DOVE Fall 2027 is
$25,000 academic year plus tuition/health but ineligible for F 1. [s8] [s9] [s10] [s24]
Years of support [Standing rule]
All admitted Ph D offers come with funding, normally TA; renewable up to 6 years subject to conditions and
progress. Summer employment is separate unless offer explicitly includes it. [s1] [s8]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
International students can hold ordinary graduate assistantships subject to enrollment/work authorization and
TA language certification. DOVE explicitly excludes international temporary-status students; F 1 does not meet
its lawful-nontemporary category. Federal citizen/PR-restricted fellowships should not be assumed available.
